meta.title: The live timer turns red under ten minutes and offers "Extend time"
gaps: The fixed prepared state is an upcoming RFQ, not a live auction with 12 minutes remaining; the required auction lifecycle cannot be established.
No catalog step can watch the timer cross ten minutes or assert that its ring changes to red.
The timer's plus icon has no confirmed accessible target for hovering and asserting the "Extend time" tooltip.
No available step can advance this fixed event to closing and then assert "Ended".
The upcoming-to-live transition cannot be triggered or awaited with the available steps, so the "Your auction is live" toast cannot be meaningfully asserted.
